content.text:
I submitted index 13 (Co 0.35 / V 0.65) as the best composition. It gave 1.16 µA, the highest photocurrent of the three I measured, and the whole merit budget is now spent.

| Index | Co fraction | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.20 | 0.51 µA |
| **13** | **0.35** | **1.16 µA** |
| 11 | 0.48 | 0.08 µA |

Photocurrent peaks near the CoV₂O₆ composition, where Co is about a third of the cations. MEGNet predicts a 2.33 eV band gap for CoV₂O₆, so it absorbs the 3.22 eV light. All the other phases I checked (V₂O₅, CoV₅O₁₂, Co₂V₂O₇, Co₃V₂O₈) also have predicted gaps below 3.22 eV, so the band gaps didn't help pick between compositions. My choices came from where the measured trend pointed.

The best composition may still be unmeasured:
- **Unmeasured neighbours:** I only measured 3 of the 15 candidates. Index 10 (Co 0.29) and index 4 (Co 0.42) sit on either side of the peak and could beat index 13.
- **Co-rich end untested:** I skipped everything above Co 0.48 because photocurrent was dropping sharply by 0.48.
- **XRD unused:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD scans, so which phases are actually in these films is unconfirmed.
